title: docs: profile name and email need account:profile only
author: Connectslide121

gist.summary: Corrected the `/account/profile` API reference: the `name` and `email` fields require `account:profile`; `account:keys` alone does not return them. The field descriptions now match the handler, route description, and `/api/device/userinfo` documentation. No API behavior changed.
